posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-balance 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9c06a2c7534dff9e704f.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-balance is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9c06a2c7534dff9e704f.html
